passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 08
passage.text:
📱 TEXT MESSAGE A - From: Mom (2:15 PM)

Hi honey! Running late due to unexpected traffic. Can you start dinner? There's chicken in the fridge - just defrost it in the microwave. I should be home around 6. Love you!

💬 SOCIAL MEDIA POST B - @FitnessGuru (May 7)

Day 30 of my fitness challenge! Feeling accomplished and stronger than ever. Remember: progress is gradual - don't expect instant results. Stay consistent and the results will come! #FitnessJourney

📧 EMAIL C - Community Garden Meeting

The meeting scheduled for Saturday has been postponed to next week. Heavy rain is predicted and our outdoor venue won't be suitable. We'll notify you of the new date soon.

💼 WORK SLACK MESSAGE D - From: Alex (4:30 PM)

Great job on the presentation today! Your explanation was very clear and concise. The client seemed impressed. I think we have a good chance of securing this contract!
